# HEARTz

> A free browser-based workspace for guided soundscapes, custom tones, binaural differences and local audio retuning.

The public landing offers short playable audio samples without an account. The full application requires an account and supports email/password and Google sign-in through Firebase Authentication. English is the default application language.

The Converter processes supported WAV and FLAC files locally without uploading source audio. Its natural-resample method changes pitch, tempo and duration. Saved recipes and settings stay in the signed-in account's current browser profile; they do not sync across devices or store audio tracks.

## Product information

- [Product reference](https://heartz.app/llms-full.txt): Tools, suitable uses, formats, retuning behavior and local storage limitations.
- [Audio samples](https://heartz.app/#demo-player): Short WAV samples, including a three-second 440/432 Hz comparison.
- [Data and privacy](https://heartz.app/privacy): Account handling, local audio processing and configured external services.

## Application

- [Create an account](https://app.heartz.app/signup): Free application registration.
- [Sign in](https://app.heartz.app/login): Access an existing account.
- [Converter](https://app.heartz.app/converter): Retune supported WAV/FLAC input and export uncompressed WAV.
- [Frequency Lab](https://app.heartz.app/frequency-lab): Configure tones, binaural differences, modulation and procedural noise.
- [Guided](https://app.heartz.app/guided): Choose ready-made sessions and adjust their sound.
- [My library](https://app.heartz.app/library): Reopen locally saved recipes and settings.
- [Learn](https://app.heartz.app/learn): Read explanations and referenced research.
